description: Two layers, deliberately different in kind. PreToolUse on Write/Edit/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit DENIES a write to any path outside the owns set of the wave declared in .drydock/wave-owns.json. PostToolUse on Bash cannot deny -- the command has already run -- so it DETECTS instead, recording any file that changed outside that set, plus an `observed` receipt when nothing did. Both are inert when .drydock/wave-owns.json is absent, which is the normal state of a repo not mid-wave. Prevention is file-tool only and always will be: the set of commands that write is not decidable from a command string. See hooks/enforce-owns.mjs and hooks/detect-bash-writes.mjs for the config shape, the rationale, and the ceilings each layer carries.
